rows.text: The police aircar weaves through the tangled lanes of drone traffic, touching down smoothly atop a three-thousand-story skyscraper. Seven minutes have passed since the emergency call, and as a High-Risk Biohazard Disposal Specialist, you've finally made it to the crime scene.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "It's a shapeshifter. It's already tricked a few of our officers — stay alert." The on-site officer sends a data packet straight to your neural link. The next thing you know, a stabbing pain rips through your skull.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Ahahaha! Got another one!" The officer's body liquefies into a writhing mass of slime — then reshapes itself into a giant, mocking middle finger.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Not the best start to this mission... but a tactical retreat is better than a reckless demise. You can deal with it another day.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
